newsitem.title: USA: FPL says St Lucie 1 back in a few days.
newsitem.headline: FPL says St Lucie 1 back in a few days.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co said it expected to begin putting electricity on the grid from its 839 megawatt (MW) St Lucie 1 nuclear power plant sometime this week.
"We expect it to resume within the next day or so," said company spokeswoman Janice Brady.

The unit was taken off line late Saturday after a leak was detected in one of the Hutchinson Island, Fla., unit's transformers, the spokeswoman said. "We found some air leakage into a transformer, and there was an oil drip," she said.
Lost production was expected to be made up from FPL's remaining power generating units, Brady said.
"Typically we have enough generation to make up for the loss of a unit, although we could purchase some power if we could get it cheaper than it would cost to produce," she said.
The 839 MW St Lucie nuclear unit 2, also at Hutchinson Island, was operating at 100 percent output, Brady said.
